description: This file contains a report generation script for monthly attendance sheets in an HR module, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and chart data creation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the attendance report based on filters, returning columns, data, and chart data.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data (line chart) for attendance metrics over days.

methods.name: add_data
methods.description: Processes employee attendance data and compiles report rows.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters and whether the view is summarized.

methods.name: get_attendance_list
methods.description: Fetches attendance status for employees for the specified period.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for attendance data retrieval based on filters.

methods.name: get_employee_details
methods.description: Retrieves employee details, optionally grouped by a specified attribute.

methods.name: get_holiday
methods.description: Fetches holiday data for given holiday list and month.

methods.name: get_attendance_years
methods.description: Returns a list of years for which attendance data exists.
